name: Customer purchases virtual assets and sends them immediately to a new wallet
description: A first-time or unsophisticated buyer buys a large amount and withdraws it all to an unfamiliar address, consistent with a victim ransom payment.

sources.text: FinCEN, Advisory on Ransomware and the Use of the Financial System to Facilitate Ransom Payments (FIN-2021-A004, 2021)
FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2020)
